python3.selection: CPython 3.15.2 PSF/Python notices; retain local change summary, mimalloc MIT, HACL MIT and KaRaMeL Apache-2.0/MIT notices; no Tcl/Tk or GNU Readline

libffi.selection: MIT; retain copyright and permission notice

zlib.selection: Zlib; preserve origin and mark source modifications

openssl.selection: Apache-2.0 for 3.x; retain license and applicable NOTICE/attribution, mark modifications

sqlite3.selection: Public Domain deliverable SQLite library; retain upstream provenance

zstd.selection: BSD-3-Clause branch of BSD OR GPL dual license; retain BSD binary redistribution notices

bzip2.selection: bzip2-1.0.6 permissive license; retain notices and mark modified sources

liblzma.selection: 0BSD library only; CPython does not enable tools or ship XZ GPL helper scripts; full 0BSD notice in supplements

expat.selection: MIT AND CC0-1.0; retain Expat and SipHash notices

brotli.selection: MIT; retain copyright and permission notice

icu.selection: ICU 78.3 Unicode-3.0 plus bundled permissive third-party notices; retain the complete upstream LICENSE including historical ICU and data notices

boost.selection: Official empty umbrella port; reuse the installed boost-headers BSL-1.0 notice; collect each Boost module separately

qtbase.selection: LGPL-3.0 runtime modules including Qt Test and session management; retain embedded third-party notices. windeployqt is a separate GPL-3.0-only WITH Qt-GPL-exception-1.0 development tool, excluded from the application runtime closure; redistribution of the tool requires its own license compliance

qtserialbus.selection: LGPL-3.0 runtime/CAN plugins; canbusutil is a separate GPL tool, excluded from the application runtime closure

qttools.selection: Development tools; GPL tool components must be separated from application runtime

qtshadertools.selection: Review runtime/tool split and embedded compiler licenses

qtlanguageserver.selection: Development tool dependency; do not link to closed application without a compatible license

cgal.selection: Only license-reviewed modules and headers compatible with proprietary commercial distribution; not limited to LGPL (e.g. LGPL, BSL, BSD); exclude GPL modules and headers that directly or indirectly depend on them; apply each file's actual license terms; re-review before upgrades or whitelist expansion

cccorelib.selection: LGPL-2.0-or-later, MIT and private nanoflann BSD notices; shared

opencascade.selection: LGPL-2.1 with OCCT exception; preserve exact notices/exception

qt-advanced-docking-system.selection: LGPL; use exact shipped license text

libiconv.selection: GNU libiconv library uses LGPL when actually built; executable tools have separate licenses. Linux normally installs only a vcpkg MIT CMake wrapper for system libc iconv. The wrapper notice does not replace the system implementation's license

pthread.selection: Linux metadata-only compatibility port; POSIX threads are provided by the OS. The collected MIT notice covers vcpkg metadata only

pthreads.selection: Linux metadata-only port; no Pthreads4W code, headers or library are shipped. The collected MIT notice covers vcpkg metadata only

dirent.selection: Linux metadata-only port; directory APIs are provided by the OS. The collected MIT notice covers vcpkg metadata only

opengl.selection: Linux installs only vcpkg metadata and usage text, covered by vcpkg MIT; actual OpenGL implementation is provided by the OS and has its own license. Windows retains the actual Windows SDK notice

egl.selection: Linux installs only a vcpkg MIT CMake wrapper and metadata; the OS EGL implementation must be reviewed separately if redistributed

libbacktrace.selection: BSD-3-Clause; retain the complete upstream notice

libuuid.selection: Mixed BSD-3-Clause source notices and the unversioned LGPL notice in randutils.c; LGPL-2.1 route recorded with complete supplemental texts. Official port provides a static archive; not approved as an unconditionally permissive application static-link dependency. Direct application linkage requires LGPL corresponding-source and relinking compliance
libuuid.reviewed_source_license: BSD-3-Clause AND LGPL (unversioned upstream notice; LGPL-2.1 selected)

fontconfig.selection: MIT; retain the complete COPYING and bundled notices; gperf is a separate build-time generator

gperf.selection: GPL-3.0-or-later development/build tool; excluded from the application runtime closure. Redistribution of the tool requires its own GPL compliance. Generated output follows the input's copyright/license rather than inheriting gperf's GPL

paho-mqtt.selection: EDL-1.0 branch verified in 1.3.16 LICENSE/NOTICE; full EDL text in supplemental notices

paho-mqttpp3.selection: EDL-1.0 branch verified in 1.6.0 LICENSE/about.html; full EDL text in supplemental notices

gl2ps.selection: GL2PS license branch; retain original GL2PS conditions

vtk.selection: BSD and selected third-party notices; inspect actual modules

pcl.selection: BSD-3-Clause plus OpenNURBS notice for surface-on-nurbs; uses public ZLIB and Eigen solver, not UMFPACK

tcl.selection: Tcl/Tk permissive terms plus bundled extension notices

tk.selection: Tcl/Tk permissive terms; private source notices included
